prompt: A teammate has been benched for an important match and is sitting quietly while two others joke about them not being good enough. What is the kindest useful response?

options.text: Join in lightly so the group does not turn on you instead
Tell the coach the others should be benched as punishment
Pretend you did not hear the jokes and focus on your own warm-up
Change the subject away from the jokes and check in with the benched teammate directly

explanation: Deflecting the teasing and checking in directly supports the teammate without starting a bigger confrontation on match day.
